recognize_zh: 左上方一顆顆粒狀血小板大小接近紅血球，與右下方小淋巴球的核相近；整個視野正常大小血小板非常稀少，紅血球形態大致正常，符合巨大血小板合併血小板減少的 Bernard-Soulier 症候群。
features: Giant platelet at upper left approaching the diameter of adjacent red cells, with centrally concentrated purple granules and a pale hyaline rim
Marked paucity of normal-sized platelets in the field (apparent thrombocytopenia)
Small mature lymphocyte for size comparison
Red cells largely normocytic and normochromic without schistocytes or spherocytes
No leukocyte inclusions (Döhle-like bodies) seen in the single leukocyte present
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic, normochromic red cells without fragmentation. Platelets are markedly decreased in the field, and the platelet present at the upper left is a giant form approaching the size of a red cell, with granules concentrated centrally. A small mature lymphocyte is present; the leukocyte shows no cytoplasmic inclusions. In the appropriate clinical context, giant platelets with thrombocytopenia are consistent with Bernard-Soulier syndrome, which is confirmed by absent ristocetin-induced aggregation and reduced GPIb-IX-V on flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: MYH9 disorders show similar giant platelets but have blue Döhle-like inclusions in neutrophils and normal ristocetin aggregation.
ITP shows a spectrum of mildly enlarged young platelets rather than uniformly giant platelets, with normal GPIb expression and normal ristocetin response.
Gray platelets are large but pale gray and agranular, unlike the granulated giant platelet here.
EDTA-induced clumps form aggregates of normal-sized platelets, whereas this is a single enlarged platelet.
